data.text: Before we head out, how about we each take 10 tons this month? That leaves 50 tons, which doubles back to 100 for next month. We’d each earn $10,000, and we could keep that income going without draining the lake our village depends on. My family taught me to leave enough for the next catch. Let’s agree on that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you support that?
